Changelog audit fixes: OK, X and Escape all acknowledge it; it always opens on the newest version; Show changelog gone from Settings (the button next to "Welcome home," stays, now also while the leaderboards fail to load or download). A CrazyGames player who had not left the tutorial before this run gets the release acknowledged quietly - only the next one opens. Only popups still drawn make it wait (a modal of a window it hides stayed in ImGui's popup stack and kept it waiting for good); "last exit was incorrect" shows before it; the auto-open check runs once per run. A "## " heading counts as a version only with X.Y.Z (is_valid_version next to is_more_recent). is_new_version without dead branches, perform_changelog_view static, stale comments. Shop audit fixes: the buy menu collects each category's items at most once per frame; Spells is shown only with a spell buyable by this player (faction, whitelist, price), one list for both; firearms classified for the whitelists by the gun invariant, as the editor and bots do; bots' purchases filter faction, shop and price in one for_each_affordable (items priced 0 skipped, the server refuses them anyway); whitelist rows of a resource without a scene flavour are left out, one to_item_flavour_ids for whitelists and the blacklist; the firearm whitelist's notes mention guns under Tools (e.g. Blunaz); the ANY buy zone comment says why, not what was.

Nodes outside Layers keep no entity id from an earlier build (hotkeys moved an unrelated node). Clone, mirror and Shift+N do nothing on the Scratchpad's selection (the copy landed in Layers, i.e. in the game). Nodes are moved within the Scratchpad and between it and Layers (reorder_nodes_command walks both lists, the dragged node's id travels in the payload, dropping on New layer no longer reads an empty selection). Keeping the Scratchpad and Layers apart in the selection is decided by the first selected layer or node - Ctrl+A on de_cyberaqua took seconds. F2 and arrows in the Scratchpad window.
